title: 第3章 我穿越在人界第4章 炎门弟子资质测试
content_zh:
异能大陆分为八个大界分别是——人界，兽界，魔界，羽界，龙界，机械界，源古界和地下渊界。
我穿越在了人界，一个界地又分为好几个国家，我这里一共六个国家，我在其中的麦香国，这里有异能修行者的七大门派，而我就是其中炎门的后勤人员，连弟子都不是，在这里还救命债。
看着最劳累辛苦的活，还没有任何报酬，我都快发疯了，应无悔怀念起上大学时的日子，是那样的无忧无虑，轻松自左。
虽然生活十分无聊和不如意，但偷偷地听学堂上课还挺有意思。
应无悔爬到大树上，每天都会来学堂听一会，有些时候会讲异能，有些时候会讲规矩，有些时候又会讲庞大的世界观，我总算懂了，这么多界地，界地上有许多种族，而我们这是人族自己治理的，主总族一共列为十个，只有强大的种族才能被列为主总族，他们所拥有的异能者最多，一些小派的种族更是多如繁星，他们受到大种族的管治。
钟声响起，学堂里的人出来，他们都是炎门弟子，穿着火红华丽的衣服，他们踱步而出，议论纷纷。
“再过几天就是门内的异能资质测试，我有些紧张”
“慌什么？这种东西是老天注定的，没有人能改变”
“也对，资质高的人，修行速度就会越快，也越会得到门内长老们和掌门的重视”
“嗯，希望我们的运气能好点”
两个炎门弟子说道。
应无悔在旁边扫地时听到了，异能资质测试，就是像考试一样的吧，那天那个高大的人，所展示的就是异能。
“喂，好好扫地！
别不长眼睛，碰到了别人，那可有你好果子吃！”
焱言从另一个学堂走出，许多新生向他打着招呼，他是本门弟子，从小就俢行异能，是一级异能高阶的强者，许多学弟学妹们，纷纷投来羡慕的目光，不断地向他问好，他只是抬抬手。
身后水灵的小师妹也是本门弟子，修为为一级异能中阶。
“好漂亮的师姐”
“哎，你听说没有？本门弟子只有不到区区五十个人！”
“真的吗？那也太厉害了”
“他们的异能境界都好高啊，我连心景都没开”

学弟学妹们议论道。
“好的，一定好好扫，您请走”
应无悔毕恭毕敬道，这十几天来可没少受他的欺负，不过没办法，在绝对的实力面前，我根本没法招架。
“嗯，小心点扫，弄脏人的衣服可就不好了”
焱言咄咄逼人，不过应无悔毕恭毕敬的样子让他满意，这样才是一个庶民，一个奴隶该有的样子！
他终于走了，我要快点扫，趁时间还能赶上他们聊天的空闲时。
终于扫完了，又这样过了一天，怀念回到后勤食堂，中年阿姨仍坐在这里缝补衣物。
应无悔看了看小木桌上的两个馒头和一碗白粥，又是阿姨帮他抢的，在这里总是食不裹腹，这里的后勤人员一但到了开饭时间，就都跟疯狗似的上前狂抢，阿姨是这里的管理人，所以她有特权先拿，那些人站着不敢动，一但她拿了，那些人就解放了，开始恶虎扑食。
“谢谢你啊，阿姨”
应无悔得感谢她，要不是她，自己可能会被活活饿死。
“叫我沈娘”
中年阿姨说道，“好”
content_en:
The superpower continent is divided into eight major realms: the human realm, the beast realm, the demon realm, the feather realm, the dragon realm, the mechanical realm, the ancient realm and the underground abyss realm.
I traveled through the human world, and each world is divided into several countries. There are six countries in total here, and I am in the Maixiang Kingdom. There are seven sects of supernatural practitioners here, and I am the support staff of the Yan Sect. I am not even a disciple. I am here to pay my life debt.
Seeing the most tiring and arduous work without any reward, I almost went crazy. Ying Wu regretted remembering the days when he was in college, so carefree and relaxed.
Although life is very boring and unsatisfactory, it is quite interesting to secretly listen to the class.
Ying Wuhui climbed up the big tree and came to the school to listen for a while every day. Sometimes he would talk about superpowers, sometimes he would talk about rules, and sometimes he would talk about the huge world view. I finally understood that there are so many worlds, and there are many races in the world, and we are governed by the human race. There are ten main races in total, and only powerful races can be classified as main races. They have the most superpowers, and some small factions have as many races as stars. They are governed by the big race.
The bell rang, and the people in the school came out. They were all disciples of the Yan Clan, dressed in red and gorgeous clothes. They walked out and talked about it.
"In a few days, there will be a test for supernatural abilities inside the door. I'm a little nervous."
"Why are you panicking? This kind of thing is destined by God and no one can change it."
"That's right. People with higher qualifications will practice faster, and the more they will be valued by the elders and heads of the sect."
"Well, I hope our luck will be better."
The two Yanmen disciples said.
Ying Wuhui heard it when he was sweeping the floor next to him. The superpower qualification test was just like an exam. What the tall man showed that day was his superpower.
“Hey, sweep the floor well!
Don't be blind, if you meet someone else, you will be rewarded! "
Yan Yan walked out of another school, and many new students greeted him. He was a disciple of his own, and he had been practicing supernatural powers since he was a child. He was a powerful person with high-level first-level powers. Many juniors and juniors cast envious glances at him and kept saying hello to him, but he just raised his hand.
The little junior sister Shui Ling behind him is also a disciple of our sect, and her cultivation is at the mid-level level of first-level superpowers.
"What a beautiful senior sister"
"Hey, have you heard? There are less than fifty disciples in our sect!"
"Really? That's awesome."
"Their abilities are so high, I haven't even opened my mind yet."
The junior students discussed.
"Okay, make sure to clean it well. Please leave."
Ying Wuhui said respectfully, I have been bullied by him a lot in the past ten days, but there is no way, in the face of absolute strength, I can't resist at all.
"Well, be careful when you sweep, it won't be good if you dirty someone's clothes."
Yan Yan was aggressive, but he should be satisfied with his respectful and respectful manner. This is how a common man and a slave should behave!
He finally left, so I had to scan quickly while I still had time to catch up with them chatting.
I finally finished sweeping, and another day passed like this. I missed going back to the logistics canteen, where the middle-aged aunt was still sitting here mending clothes.
Ying Wuhui looked at the two steamed buns and a bowl of porridge on the small wooden table. It was his aunt who helped him grab it. He always had enough to eat here. As soon as it was time to eat, the logistics staff here rushed forward like mad dogs to grab it. The aunt was the manager here, so she had the privilege to take it first. Those people stood there and did not dare to move. Once she took it, those people were liberated and began to attack the food fiercely.
"Thank you, Auntie"
Ying Wuhui had to thank her. If it weren't for her, he might have starved to death.
"Call me Mother Shen"
The middle-aged aunt said, "Okay"
